question.text: The minimum corpus required for each scheme of an AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Each scheme of an AIF shall have a corpus — the aggregate of capital commitments — of at least INR 20 crore as per SEBI (AIF) Regulations. Management fees and operating expenses are charged separately and are negotiated/disclosed under the fund documents. The Trap: INR 20 crore is the per-scheme minimum corpus floor, not a per-fund or per-manager figure, and not the typical fund size. Don't conflate scheme-level corpus with fund-level corpus or with target size. Note: The corpus is the aggregate of capital commitments received by the scheme, and the INR 20 crore minimum must be reached before the scheme can commence its investment activity.
